originalTitle: US stocks: S&P 500 ends higher as investors await tech earnings
simplifiedContent: The US stock market had a good day on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 index going up. This was helped by big companies like Boeing and Coca-Cola doing well. However, companies that make computer chips had a bad day because investors are waiting to see how well big tech companies like Microsoft and Amazon did. Apple's stock value reached a new high of over $5 trillion, which is a big deal. The market is also waiting to see what the Federal Reserve decides about interest rates on Wednesday, which could affect the market.

originalTitle: Apple briefly tops $5 trillion in market value, second after Nvidia; unveils iPhone leasing scheme
simplifiedContent: Apple's total value on the stock market recently went up to over $5 trillion, which is a very big deal. This makes Apple only the second company to reach this milestone, with Nvidia being the first. To put it simply, market value is the total worth of a company's shares. This is important because it shows how well a company is doing and how much investors trust it. Reaching a market value of $5 trillion is a significant achievement for Apple, showing its strong position in the market.

originalTitle: Manipal Health IPO: Co. garners Rs 4,167 crore from anchor investors; ADIA, Morgan Stanley among investors
simplifiedContent: Manipal Health Enterprises, a company that wants to list its shares on the stock market, has already raised a large amount of money, Rs 4,167 crore, from big investors like ADIA and Morgan Stanley. This money was raised before the company's initial public offering (IPO) even starts, which will happen on July 29. The company is trying to raise a total of Rs 9,275 crore from its IPO. The money raised will be used to pay off debts and buy other hospitals to grow its network. This is important because it shows that big investors are interested in the company, which could make its IPO successful.

originalTitle: Chip Rout Sinks Emerging-Market Stocks; Currencies Trade Mixed
simplifiedContent: There was a big drop in the value of companies that make semiconductors (also known as computer chips). This drop had a ripple effect and hurt the stock markets in Asia, causing the overall value of emerging markets to fall to its lowest point in over three months. As a result, the benchmark, which is like a report card for emerging markets, is not doing well. The value of currencies, or money, is also unclear and mixed, meaning some are going up and some are going down. This is all happening just before the Federal Reserve, a important group that helps control the US economy, makes a big decision.

originalTitle: TSX hits record high, led by tech and financial shares
simplifiedContent: The Canadian stock market, also known as the TSX, has reached its highest point ever. This means that the overall value of the companies listed on the TSX has never been higher. The main reason for this record high is because technology and financial companies are doing well, which is driving up the entire market. This is significant because it shows that investors are confident in the Canadian economy and are willing to put their money into these companies. As a result, people who have invested in the TSX may see the value of their investments increase.

originalTitle: Citadel Securities’ Fed Rate Hike Call Adds to Market Angst
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: The Federal Reserve, which helps control the US economy, is about to make a decision about interest rates. Most people think they will keep interest rates the same, but some important people on Wall Street, like those at Citadel Securities, think they will raise them. This is causing some worry among bond traders, who are waiting to see what the Fed will do. The decision is especially important because it's one of the first big decisions made by the new Chairman, Kevin Warsh. This uncertainty is making the market a bit nervous as people wait for the Fed's decision.
